rationale: The assistant correctly read E:09 as a heating fault, identified the integrated heater/circulation pump assembly as the likely cause, and sensibly handed off to an engineer without recommending a part or any unsafe work. However, it twice asserted 'This is typically not an expensive fix' without knowing the machine's age or the cost of a Bosch heat pump assembly, which was the customer's actual question, and never asked about age or raised repair-vs-replace economics. It also did not offer the isolated resistance test as a DIY option or any isolation guidance, so the homeowner leaves with a plausible cause but a potentially misleading cost expectation.
